title: Core Utilities and Configuration
summary: This module provides a collection of core utilities for various functionalities like console output, experimental evaluation, hook management, knowledge source handling, project annotations, security configuration, telemetry, streaming, and task output storage. It centralizes common helper functions and configuration patterns used across the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Printer
nodes.title: Console Output Handler
nodes.description: Handles formatted console output, including colored text, while respecting suppression contexts.

nodes.label: _ShimFinder
nodes.title: CLI Import Shim
nodes.description: Maps 'crewai.cli' imports to 'crewai_cli' to ensure proper module resolution and compatibility.

nodes.label: BaseEvaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Evaluation Base
nodes.description: Provides an abstract base class for defining and implementing experimental evaluation metrics for agents and tasks.

nodes.label: Run Experiment
nodes.title: Experiment Execution
nodes.description: Executes a defined experiment using a dataset, crew, and agents, returning detailed results.

nodes.label: Assert Experiment Success
nodes.title: Experiment Result Validation
nodes.description: Validates experiment results against a baseline, raising an assertion error if regressions or failures are detected.

nodes.label: Clear All Global Hooks
nodes.title: Global Hook Reset
nodes.description: Clears all globally registered LLM and tool call hooks, useful for testing or resetting application state.

nodes.label: Hook Decorator Factory
nodes.title: Decorator Generator for Hooks
nodes.description: A factory function that generates decorators for creating and registering various types of hooks, with optional filtering by agents or tools.

nodes.label: Before LLM Call Hook
nodes.title: Pre-LLM Call Decorator
nodes.description: Decorator to register a function that executes before an LLM call, allowing for pre-processing or logging.

nodes.label: After LLM Call Hook
nodes.title: Post-LLM Call Decorator
nodes.description: Decorator to register a function that executes after an LLM call, enabling post-processing or response modification.

nodes.label: Before Tool Call Hook
nodes.title: Pre-Tool Call Decorator
nodes.description: Decorator to register a function that executes before a tool call, useful for validation or human approval.

nodes.label: After Tool Call Hook
nodes.title: Post-Tool Call Decorator
nodes.description: Decorator to register a function that executes after a tool call, allowing for result logging or sanitization.

nodes.label: Before LLM Hook Wrapper
nodes.title: LLM Pre-Call Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'before_llm_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: After LLM Hook Wrapper
nodes.title: LLM Post-Call Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'after_llm_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: Before Tool Hook Wrapper
nodes.title: Tool Pre-Call Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'before_tool_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: After Tool Hook Wrapper
nodes.title: Tool Post-Call Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'after_tool_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: BaseFileKnowledgeSource
nodes.title: Base for File Knowledge
nodes.description: An abstract base class for knowledge sources that load and process content from various file types.

nodes.label: CrewDoclingSource
nodes.title: Docling Document Source
nodes.description: A knowledge source that converts and processes documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.) using the Docling library for content extraction and chunking.

nodes.label: ExcelKnowledgeSource
nodes.title: Excel Data Source
nodes.description: A knowledge source that loads and processes content from Excel files, converting sheets to CSV format for embedding and querying.

nodes.label: @task
nodes.title: Task Method Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class method as a CrewAI task, enabling its integration into a crew's workflow with memoization.

nodes.label: @wrapper
nodes.title: Crew Setup Method Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that wraps a method to set up and instantiate crew components (agents, tasks) before the wrapped method is called.

nodes.label: @agent
nodes.title: Agent Method Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class method as a CrewAI agent, facilitating its definition and integration into a crew.

nodes.label: @llm
nodes.title: LLM Provider Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class method as an LLM provider, allowing for dynamic LLM configuration within a crew.

nodes.label: @tool
nodes.title: Tool Method Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class method as a CrewAI tool, making it available for agents to use.

nodes.label: @cache_handler
nodes.title: Cache Handler Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class method as a cache handler, enabling custom caching logic for crew components.

nodes.label: @before_kickoff
nodes.title: Pre-Kickoff Hook Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a method for execution before the crew's kickoff process begins.

nodes.label: @after_kickoff
nodes.title: Post-Kickoff Hook Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a method for execution after the crew's kickoff process has completed.

nodes.label: @output_json
nodes.title: JSON Output Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class, indicating that its output should be formatted as JSON.

nodes.label: @output_pydantic
nodes.title: Pydantic Output Annotation
nodes.description: Decorator to mark a class, indicating that its output should conform to a Pydantic model.

nodes.label: _CrewBaseType
nodes.title: CrewBase Metaclass
nodes.description: A metaclass for CrewBase that allows it to be used as a decorator, transforming classes into CrewAI crew definitions.

nodes.label: Memoization Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Memoization Utility
nodes.description: An asynchronous wrapper utility that provides caching and memoization for function calls, improving performance by storing and reusing results.

nodes.label: DecoratedMethod
nodes.title: Base Method Wrapper
nodes.description: A generic base wrapper for methods that have been decorated, preserving their signature and adding metadata.

nodes.label: SecurityConfig
nodes.title: Security Configuration Manager
nodes.description: Manages security settings for CrewAI agents, including unique fingerprints for component identification.

nodes.label: Load Skill Resources
nodes.title: Skill Resource Loader
nodes.description: Promotes a skill to a 'RESOURCES' disclosure level, making its associated resources available.

nodes.label: Telemetry System
nodes.title: Anonymous Usage Telemetry
nodes.description: Handles anonymous telemetry for the CrewAI package, collecting usage data for various operations like crew creation, task execution, and tool usage.

nodes.label: String to Callable Converter
nodes.title: Dotted-Path Resolver
nodes.description: Converts a dotted-path string (e.g., 'module.function') into the corresponding callable object, with warnings for non-serializable callables.

nodes.label: StreamingOutputBase
nodes.title: Base for Streaming Output
nodes.description: Provides a base class for handling streaming output, allowing iteration over chunks and access to the final result after completion.

nodes.label: Summarize LLM Messages
nodes.title: LLM Conversation Summarizer
nodes.description: Asynchronously summarizes a chunk of LLM conversation messages into a concise summary.

nodes.label: Display Agent Logs
nodes.title: Agent Execution Logger
nodes.description: Formats and displays agent execution logs, including thoughts, tool usage, and final answers, with optional verbosity.

nodes.label: Run Crew Tool with Messages
nodes.title: Crew Tool Execution
nodes.description: Executes a specified crew tool, passing along messages and other keyword arguments.

nodes.label: Retrieve Execution Files
nodes.title: Crew Execution File Access
nodes.description: Retrieves files associated with a specific crew execution ID from storage.

nodes.label: Retrieve Task Files
nodes.title: Task File Access
nodes.description: Retrieves files associated with a specific task ID from storage.

nodes.label: Serialize Guardrails
nodes.title: Guardrail JSON Serialization
nodes.description: Serializes guardrail configurations into a JSON-compatible format, filtering out non-serializable callables.

nodes.label: Sanitize Bedrock Tool Params
nodes.title: Bedrock Tool Parameter Sanitizer
nodes.description: Adjusts and sanitizes JSON schema for tool parameters to comply with Bedrock Converse strict tool use requirements.

nodes.label: Object to JSON String
nodes.title: JSON String Conversion
nodes.description: Serializes a given Python object into a JSON-formatted string, returning None if the object is empty or not serializable.

nodes.label: Streaming Event Handler
nodes.title: LLM Stream Processor
nodes.description: Handles and processes incoming LLM stream chunk events, directing them to appropriate queues for synchronous or asynchronous consumption.

nodes.label: Text Slugifier
nodes.title: URL-Safe Slug Generator
nodes.description: Converts a given text string into a URL-safe slug by normalizing Unicode, removing special characters, and replacing spaces.

nodes.label: Task Output Storage
nodes.title: Task Output Persistence Manager
nodes.description: Manages the storage and retrieval of task execution outputs, supporting features like replay and audit trails using an SQLite backend.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: External Large Language Model
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model used for generating summaries or other text-based tasks.

nodes.label: Run Crew Tool
nodes.title: Core Crew Tool Execution
nodes.description: A core function responsible for the actual execution of a crew's defined tools.

nodes.label: File Storage System
nodes.title: Persistent File Storage
nodes.description: An underlying system for persistent storage and retrieval of files associated with crew executions and tasks.

nodes.label: Anthropic Tool Param Sanitizer
nodes.title: Anthropic Tool Parameter Utility
nodes.description: An external utility specifically designed to sanitize tool parameters for Anthropic's LLM models.

nodes.label: Serialization Utility
nodes.title: Object Serialization Helper
nodes.description: A utility function that converts complex Python objects into a basic, serializable format.

nodes.label: LLM Stream Chunk Event
nodes.title: LLM Streaming Data Event
nodes.description: An event object representing a single chunk of data received from an LLM in a streaming context.

nodes.label: SQLite Storage
nodes.title: SQLite Database Backend
nodes.description: An SQLite database implementation used as the backend for storing task outputs.

groups.label: Core System Utilities
groups.title: Foundational System Helpers
groups.description: Provides fundamental utilities for console interaction, CLI import management, text processing, and object serialization.

groups.label: Agent & Task Output Handling
groups.title: Agent and Task Result Management
groups.description: Manages the display, summarization, execution, and storage of agent and task outputs and associated files.

groups.label: Global Hook Management
groups.title: Centralized Hook Configuration
groups.description: Handles the registration, creation, and clearing of global hooks for LLM and tool calls.

groups.label: Hook Method Wrappers & Streaming
groups.title: Method Wrapping and Event Streaming
groups.description: Provides wrappers for specific hook methods and handles the processing of streaming events from LLMs.

groups.label: Knowledge & Data Sources
groups.title: Data Ingestion and Resource Loading
groups.description: Defines base classes and specific implementations for loading knowledge from various file types and managing skill resources.

groups.label: Project Component Annotations
groups.title: Declarative Component Definition
groups.description: Decorators for marking class methods as core CrewAI components like tasks, agents, LLMs, tools, and cache handlers.

groups.label: Project Lifecycle & Output Annotations
groups.title: Crew Lifecycle and Output Formatting
groups.description: Decorators for defining methods to run at specific points in the crew's lifecycle and for specifying output formats.

groups.label: Project Annotation Infrastructure
groups.title: Underlying Annotation Framework
groups.description: Provides the foundational metaclass and generic wrappers that enable the declarative annotation system for CrewAI projects.

groups.label: Security, Compliance & Evaluation
groups.title: Security, Guardrails, and Experiment Evaluation
groups.description: Manages security configurations, serializes guardrails, sanitizes tool parameters, and provides tools for experimental evaluation.

groups.label: Telemetry & Streaming Base
groups.title: Usage Monitoring and Streaming Foundation
groups.description: Handles anonymous usage telemetry for the framework and provides a base for managing streaming output.
